subject: gk
question: Among the given options, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment doesn't patronise _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**e-Shram.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment** doesn't patronize e-Shram among the given options.
 
• **e-Shram** is an initiative launched by the **Ministry of Labour and Employment** to provide universal social security coverage to workers in the unorganized sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan** is a campaign launched by the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment** to make India drug-free.
 
• **e-ANUDAAN** is a web-based platform launched by the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment** to facilitate funding of **NGOs working **for the welfare of the differently-abled.
 
• **National Portal for Transgender persons** is a portal launched by the **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment **to provide a range of information and services to the transgender community.
